You @UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.actions.Item.o8lqmFexiwcaLpu3]{Set a Spotlight} on the target that does not move. The creature gains the lead actor role for the duration of the spell, in addition to their normally assigned role.

The lead actor gains a +1 status bonus to checks made for actions with the linguistic trait. The lead actor can @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.EEDElIyin4z60PXx]{Perform} with the linguistics trait to pull a target into a scene for 2 rounds; All creatures pulled into the same scene are @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to each other.

Heightened (4th) The lead actor can pull an additional creature into their scene each time they Perform.
